newsitem.title: USA: First Medical names CEO of physician management.
newsitem.headline: First Medical names CEO of physician management.

text.p: First Medical Corp said Wednesday that to coincide with its merger with Lehigh Group Inc, Bruce MacLeod has been appointed president and chief executive officer of First Medical's physician management division.

In addition to this position, MacLeod will become a senior vice president of First Medical, a statement from the company said. According to the definitive merger agreement announced by the two companies Tuesday, Lehigh shareholders will retain four percent of the stock in Lehigh and First Medical shareholders will hold 96 percent.

MacLeod had been vice president and general manager of Humana Health Care Plans of Tampa Bay. He succeeds Mark Kugler, who left the position last month due to illness, said First Medical Chairman and Chief Executive Dennis Sokol.
Humana Health Care Plans is a subsidiary of Humana Inc.
